body.title: Correct the pairing table, the symbol form in the validator, and the classifier prompt
body.summary: Change TARGET_TO_KINDS to the corrected rows with its comment. Make the validator split a symbol's value at the last '#' before any file-system test. Rewrite the classifier prompt's pairing list and its rule for a symbol's value. Rewrite the matrix test and add the test that compares the prompt with the table.
acceptanceChecks: The matrix test asserts every pairing of five kinds of source and seven kinds of scope against the corrected rows
A symbol value in the new form passes when its file exists and fails with 'scope-ref-unresolved' with no '#' or a file part that is not a file
A test reads the classifier prompt and finds the same rows as the exported table; changing one row in either makes it fail
The tests are run under Node 22 and pass

tests.name: pairing matrix: thirty-five pairings against the corrected rows
validator symbol form: passes, no '#', file part not a file
classifier prompt's pairing list equals the exported table
